title: What's New | SEO and GEO Updates | AEO Improvement
heading: What's new in AEO Improvement
description: Explore SEO and GEO product updates, guided workflow improvements, and fixes. See what changed, who it helps, and where to try it in AEO Improvement.
archiveNote: Earlier release notes retain their original recorded dates. Descriptions were clarified on September 5, 2026 to remove unsupported performance and visibility claims. Historical offers are not current plan entitlements.

entries.title: A clearer SEO and GEO workflow, without the homepage flash
entries.summary: The public site now explains how audits, suggested fixes, AI prompt tests, and paid keyword tracking work together.
items: Removed the brief flash of plain text before the designed homepage loads.
Clarified which features need a paid plan and which results are illustrative.
Kept readable page content available if JavaScript fails to load.

entries.title: SEO progress with clearer baselines and next steps
entries.summary: Paid users get more context for interpreting tracked rankings and connected search performance, alongside their improvement actions.
entries.audience: Pro and Agency for ongoing SEO tracking
items: Distinguish a missing baseline, queued collection, stale data, and an observed ranking result.
Connect page-level SEO opportunities with practical next actions.
Scheduled collection infrastructure was activated. A submitted provider task is not shown as a completed ranking result.
entries.evidence: PR #46 and scheduler PRs #47-49, merged September 5. Live scheduler delivery and queued tasks verified; no claim that all tasks produced snapshots.

entries.title: A guided dashboard and more useful follow-up emails
entries.summary: New users get a clearer starting point, and follow-up guidance points them toward the next useful action instead of another list of features.
entries.audience: New and returning users; guidance varies by plan and account progress
items: Added dashboard walkthrough and next-step guidance.
Improved free-user onboarding and access to audit actions.
Updated automated email guidance to reflect the user's next step. Delivery depends on the account's eligibility and email settings.
entries.evidence: PRs #44 and #45, merged September 4; included in the subsequently live-verified release ancestry.

entries.title: Paid tracking and weekly guidance are easier to follow
entries.summary: The paid experience brings tracking setup and weekly recommendations closer to the work users need to do on their pages.
items: Improved the SEO tracking interface and setup guidance.
Refined weekly paid-user recommendations and next-step messaging.
Kept progress reporting focused on observed changes, not claims that a particular edit caused a ranking gain.
entries.evidence: PRs #38 and #39, merged September 3; included in the subsequently live-verified release ancestry.
